'''Nogometno društvo Dravinja''', commonly referred to as '''ND Dravinja''' or simply '''Dravinja''', is a Slovenian [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Slovenske Konjice]] that competes in the [[Slovenian Second League]], the second tier of Slovenian football. The club was founded in 1934.<ref name = "Klubi"/>"}}
